title: Shoot
content: Meaning/Usage: A type of exclamation Explanation: Substitute for the profanity word "shit" "Shoot, I forgot my grocery list at home." "Oh shoot that was awkward." "Shoot, he asked Jenny to the prom instead of me." A. "Didn't you say we need to go to the grocery?" B. "Yes I did, do you want to come with me?" A. "Sure, but did you make a grocery list to take with us?" B. "Shoot I forgot. Hold on a few minutes while I make one for us." Other Common Sentences "Oh no."
